messages:
maria: Quick follow-up to the onboarding RFC 5 - proposing a compact 'admit matrix' that maps quick-bench signals to admit_score buckets and DL action. want quick takes before I draft the addendum.

maria: Key idea: single admit_score 0-100, computed from weighted checks: perf, correctness, compat. pre-admit should be fast (<10s) and only use minimal repro + pointers. deep bench async.

tom: Sounds good. keep the score auditable: we need score_breakdown list stored with the bundle so reviewers can see contributions. no opaque heuristics.

sree: For compat checks: tokenizer roundtrip + small embedding stability set. pre-admit use 8 vectors, deep bench 50. if avg cosine drop > 0.02 -> compat fail. Make the vectors configurable.

jen: Telemetry: classify signals into regression / transient / invariant-break. regression -> persist bundle + alert. transient -> retry 3x with short backoff. invariant-break -> quarantine + manual signoff.

alex: Storage policy: default keep pointers + minimal repro (prompt, token_ids, seed, model_fingerprint). Persist binaries only if org sets persist_binaries=true. pointers must be immutable (S3 version id). add checksum in metadata to detect drift.

sam: Mapping idea: admit_score >=85 -> GA, 70-85 -> canary, 50-70 -> hold (manual review), <50 -> quarantine. make thresholds org-configurable.

ops-bot: deploy-bot: onboarding-worker v3 will add admit_score and score_breakdown fields to ingestion metadata (canary rollout next week).

tom: Also add a docker-lite 'repro runner' that can be launched from the minimal bundle to replay failures locally without fetching big artifacts. Console should surface a "replay locally" button.

sree: Need a stable model_fingerprint = sha256(tokenizer_map + model_config + weights_checksum). use that for pointer validation and drift detection.

maria: Defaults for addendum: weights perf=40, correctness=40, compat=20; thresholds ga=85, canary=70, hold=50; quick_bench_timeout_ms=8000; pointers_ttl_days=30; hold_days=60; quarantine_days=180.

jen: Add required metadata in DL bundle: failing_signal, top_metric_delta, repro_prompt_id, pointer_list, checksum, runner_image_tag, assigned_oncall (opt). helps triage.

alex: I'll produce a quick cost estimate comparing pointer-only vs persist-binaries. also include per-model quick vs deep bench $ estimate.

sam: Action items: maria draft addendum (Thu), tom+sree prototype docker-lite runner + tokenizer-shim (PR in 1 week), alex cost numbers (Fri), jen telemetry spec (next Wed), ops-bot will coordinate canary.

maria: I'll include a minimal repro example and a sample admission descriptor with schema_version so future descriptor split is possible. draft will be additive and backward-compatible. tagging @tom @sree @jen @alex @sam for quick review. :rocket:
